# lidar-mcp

MCP server for YDLIDAR USB LiDAR sensors (X2, X4, G1, G4, S2, S4, S2B, S4B).

## Links
- [Source](https://github.com/sandraschi/lidar-mcp)
- [Full docs](llms-full.txt)

## Quick start
1. Plug in YDLIDAR sensor, find port: `lidar_scan(operation="ports")`
2. Set `LIDAR_PORT` env var to the detected port
3. Run `lidar_scan(operation="scan")` for a single 360-degree sweep

## Tools
- `lidar_scan` — portmanteau with operations: status, scan, ports, stream_start, stream_stop
- `show_lidar_health_card` — rich Prefab card with point cloud summary

## Env vars
- `LIDAR_PORT` — serial port (e.g. COM3, /dev/ttyUSB0)
- `LIDAR_BAUD` — override baud rate (auto-detected if omitted)

## Related fleet servers
- [yahboom-mcp](https://github.com/sandraschi/yahboom-mcp) — obstacle avoidance using this LiDAR
- [ros-mcp](https://github.com/sandraschi/ros-mcp) — ROS 2 bridge consuming scan data
